items.title: Albert Warner and Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: if Sonny is there or I'm there, he don't mind filling in for either one of us

ctx.x: That's, that's the same. I wondered whether he really wanted to or not. No, no, no, this is the truth. I'm telling you a lot. Yeah. His head ain't right. But, I'm going to tell you, that's some good even players. I'll, I'll tell you the world, anytime you jump on Jim, you're going to jump on a man. With, with, with his band and you put in the team there. But now, of course, if he, if he's going to, going to come out with, with, with the Eureka. No. It's a different attitude. You got to, change, change, change…

Just like he said, he says, if Sonny is there or I'm there, he don't mind filling in for either one of us. Yeah, I've heard him get along pretty well. But if, he said, if either one of us ain't there, he said, he don't want to play.

No. Because it's inside him. You see, I don't want against him. Against him. Nobody. If I get back up. You understand? That's the. But now, if a guy want to come in and see what he can do. This thing, you know. Well, I'm going to try and do it. You see, when he, A party get in the party now. I'm going to take my whole line. I'm going to see what he's going to do. But if a person comes out. You understand? Be nice. But I'm sure. Again. My band. I'm going to let my band fall. For. Trying to take a. Revenge. Or.…
